definitions.gloss: downward revision; downgrade; lowering of an estimate
definitions.explanation: The act of revising a figure, forecast, or assessment to a lower level. Frequently used in business and economic contexts for earnings forecasts, economic growth projections, and credit ratings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They revised their earnings forecast downward.

examples.japanese: GDP⟦{成長率|せいちょうりつ}→成長率：30165_seichouritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The GDP growth rate was revised downward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急落|きゅうらく}→急落：09399_kyuuraku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The stock price plunged following a major downward revision.

notes:
Very common in business news and financial reporting. Composed of ⟦{下方|かほう}→下方：22980_kahou⟧ (downward) + ⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧ (revision/correction).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい} — downward revision of earnings
- ⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to revise an outlook downward
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい} — a major downward revision

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上方修正|じょうほうしゅうせい}→上方修正：24821_jouhoushuusei⟧ — upward revision (the opposite)
- ⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧ — revision, correction (neutral)
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ→引き下げ：12553_hikisage⟧ — reduction, lowering
